bank: 32 forecast entries plus count and fitted parameters; one 128-coordinate update per new source
cached: 32 counts plus unique-count scalar; one update per new source
caveat: state size excludes model parameters and public source deduplication; native timing and fit cost remain separate
full_history: 32 stored observation codes plus novelty flags; recompute each prefix; sum 1..32 prefix visits
recurrent: 128 state entries plus count and fixed/fitted parameters
